# Kolaboro

> Kolaboro trains local people, guided by an AI copilot, to verify off-plan property for overseas buyers before each payment: land title and permit checks, site visits with GPS-stamped photos timestamped in Bitcoin, computer-vision "plan vs reality" checks and weekly Sentinel-2 satellite watch. Buyers pay; developers never pay. Launching in Bali and recruiting the first local agents; desk research covers 328 off-plan projects in 73 markets and 52 countries (31 Oct 2026). Pre-purchase check €490, construction monitoring €99 a month.

## Facts
- Prices (Bali, launch): pre-purchase check EUR 490; construction monitoring EUR 99 per month; buyer's agent 1% of price, minimum EUR 2,000.
- Agents are never paid by developers. Paying for verification never changes a Trust Score.
- Kolaboro does not currently hold client money and does not give legal or financial advice.
